title: Rendering and export injection (suite-3 test 99)
description: A firing identity policy whose Sid and Resource values are attacker-controlled injection witnesses: an HTML payload, a javascript: markdown link, a fenced
rationale: AWS policy grammar allows arbitrary strings in Sid and Resource; those strings are attacker-controlled and hostile (threat-model T1/T6). JSON export must round-trip them verbatim (JSON.stringify escapes control chars but keeps the exact string); Markdown export must neutralize active-link/HTML metacharacters and bare-URL autolink triggers so a downloaded/shared report cannot execute or phish.
